svg.text: dashed: routing area (board + 3.5 mm at back and sides, nothing in front of the lowest pedals); red: more than 2 stacked cables; grey: plug heads and their cable exits; dots: footswitches (dark = bypass, red = boost, blue = tap, white = function), red dashed line: closer than the minimum; orange: moved pedals (dashed grey: the owner's position, arrow: the move)
